poster_analysis.requested_action: Scan the QR code to verify eligibility and claim the scholarship

destination_analysis.apparent_purpose: Collect login and payment-card details under the pretext of releasing scholarship funds
destination_analysis.apparent_organization: Page claims 'National Scholarship Portal' but is hosted on a free weebly.com site
destination_analysis.requested_user_action: Enter email, password, card number, CVV and OTP

contradictions.destination_observation: Final page is on a free weebly.com subdomain reached through a bit.ly shortener, not a government domain

contradictions.poster_claim: Scholarship money will be paid to the student
contradictions.destination_observation: Page asks the student for card number, CVV and OTP, which are needed to take money, not to send it
Page requests a password and submits it over plain HTTP to a third-party host

evidence.fact: The final page has a form collecting card number, CVV and OTP.
The page also collects a password.
The form posts to a different origin than the page.
The form submits over unencrypted HTTP.
The destination is on free hosting (weebly.com), not a government domain.
A shortener hid the real destination and redirected across domains.
The poster's 24-hour deadline and 'congratulations, you were shortlisted' wording are classic pressure tactics.

uncertainties: The poster's issuing body could not be independently confirmed from the image.
The page content is untrusted and may differ for other visitors.
recommended_action: Do not scan or enter any details; report the poster to the institution displaying it and check scholarships only on the official government portal.
summary_for_user: The poster promises a government scholarship, but the QR code leads through a link shortener to a free-hosting page that asks for your password, card number, CVV and OTP, and sends them unencrypted to a third-party server. Genuine scholarship payments never require card or OTP details. This is a critical signal and the QR code is highly suspicious; do not use it.
